title: P/O Stevenson Memorial, St Peter and St Paul Church, Ingoldmells
location_name: St Peter and St Paul Church, High Street, Ingoldmells, Lincolnshire, England
memorial_details: The churchyard at St Peter and St Paul contains a Grade II listed memorial cross (17th century, restored 1919) with WW2 names added to the upper plinth. Whether a separate dedicated RAF memorial exists inside the church has not been confirmed from open sources. At least one RAF officer named Stevenson is documented as having family ties to Ingoldmells, which would explain a local commemorative addition, but the specific aircraft loss, date, and serial have not been recovered.

sources.title: National Churches Trust — St Peter and St Paul, Ingoldmells
